diagnosis: About a third of the dark hours are needless: 49M of 151M in long_freeze and 44M of 148M in permian_gas. Thirty of tonight's 31 flags are 'homes dark with spare power'. The AI keeps 1,000–28,000 MW of homes dark at 6–11% margin. Its answers copy the current outage total into shed_mw with restore_mw 0 ('maintain current outages'). It also cuts ahead early in the storm with margins near 10% (permian_gas h65, sensing_lines h64, flash h70) just to 'build a cushion'. Habit r4 needs margin above 5% and steady supply, but the AI's own hold answer cancels it. The physics problem (frozen plants, gas freeze-offs, failed starts) is real, but the avoidable loss is holding cuts once the cushion has returned. Past briefing edits measured -3% to -6%, and restore-trigger changes measured worse, so predictions are kept near zero.
